My dear [Lady Sophia](/person/1133)[^1]
Pray tell [Sir Arthur Gordon](/person/568) that I shall be very grateful for his Christmas papers.[^2]
We are preparing for a huge [G F S](/organisation/23) festival at [St Cross](/organisation/130), and watching the clouds with alarm

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Lady Sophia Palmer (1852-1915), was the daughter of Lord Selborne, who had been raised to an earldom on 29 December 1882.
[^2]: The Hon.

Sir Arthur Gordon (1829-1912), created (1893) Lord Stanmore, moved in 1883 from being Governor-General of New Zealand to being Governor-General of Ceylon.
